details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (financial performance highlights), K3 (installment loans in Europe), K4 (smartphone financing in Kenya and Uganda), K5 (expansion into Tanzania), K6 (AI voice agents pilot), K7 (bond tap), K8 (major bond issuance), and K9 (dividend distribution). However, it omits the detailed revenue breakdown by segment required for K2, the impairment expense details in K10, the regulatory challenge in Moldova described in K11, and the post-reporting period funding secured in K12. These omissions are material because they represent significant financial, operational, and compliance aspects of the report. While most high-importance items are covered, the missing elements are substantial enough to prevent a 'Yes' rating, resulting in a 'Generally yes' assessment.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically support the overall narrative of strong financial performance. There are no self-contradictions: revenue growth (S2), profitability improvements (S5-S7), portfolio expansion (S8-S9), geographic expansion (S10-S12), cost efficiency measures (S13), and capital market activities (S14-S16) all align with the introductory statement of record performance (S1). The organization flows logically from overall performance to specific metrics and supporting factors. There is no unnecessary repetition that reduces clarity. While numerical relationships between segment figures and consolidated totals aren't evaluated due to the financial safeguard, no explicit claims of exhaustive additivity are made that would trigger a contradiction. The summary forms a coherent whole without material internal contradictions or logical gaps.
